original_regression.failure: Committed capture incorrectly accepts omission of the original negotiated camera identity.

behavior: Commit capture requires exactly the complete set of resource identities captured by the once-only native start. Missing audio or camera, duplicates and unnegotiated identities refuse. Full exact set is accepted as captured metadata only.
scope: Store metadata only; no physical movement, decoded video readiness, video unmute, provider calls or transport qualification. Service must still supply all immutable actual negotiated identities.
